sentences.en: So to have this opportunity with this podcast to talk about what was going on in our human lives
sentences.zh: 所以通过这个播客有这样一个机会来谈谈我们人类生活里发生的事情，

sentences.en: outside of the lives we're creating on TV, you know, it's always vulnerable to share those very real things we've been through.

sentences.en: And it's presented and distributed by The Office Ladies Network and Odyssey.
sentences.zh: 本节目由 The Office Ladies Network 和 Odyssey 呈现并发行。

sentences.en: The show is also executive produced by Jenna Fisher and Angela Kinsey.
sentences.zh: 本节目的执行制片人还有珍娜·费舍尔和安吉拉·金斯利。

sentences.en: And the show is produced and edited by me, Alec Lev.
sentences.zh: 本节目由我，亚历克·莱夫制作和剪辑。

sentences.en: Our co-producer is Doug Madica.
sentences.zh: 我们的联合制片人是道格·马迪卡。

sentences.en: Our audio producer and mixer is Alex Reeves at Point of Blue Studios.
sentences.zh: 我们的音频制片人和混音师是 Point of Blue Studios 的亚历克斯·里夫斯。

sentences.en: And our Gen Z masters are digital content producer, Emily Blumberg, and associate producer,
sentences.zh: 我们的 Z 世代掌控者是数字内容制片人艾米莉·布伦贝格，以及副制片人

sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳·格罗夫。

sentences.en: Artwork by John Morrow.
sentences.zh: 封面艺术由约翰·莫罗创作。

sentences.en: Please follow, rate, and review the show on Apple Podcasts or your podcast player of choice.
sentences.zh: 请在苹果播客或您喜爱的播客平台上关注、评分和评论本节目。

sentences.en: It really does help to spread the word.
sentences.zh: 这确实有助于传播节目。

sentences.en: Our theme song is New York City by our own Josh Radner, with additional music by Craig Thomas
sentences.zh: 我们的主题曲是由我们自己的乔什·拉德纳创作的《纽约市》，克雷格·托马斯

sentences.en: and Andrew Majewski.

sentences.en: Special thanks to Sam Theobald and Elliot Connors.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢萨姆·西奥博尔德和埃利奥特·康纳斯。

sentences.en: Go to howwemadeyourmother.com to learn more and click on the contact page to send us an email

sentences.en: or a voice message.
